verdict.rationale: Solid explicitly documents streaming SSR and progressive hydration to get to interactive as quickly as possible (solid-gh-4, solid-gh-11, solid-gh-13), which directly matches the story. However, this is vendor-only evidence with no independent benchmark of streaming SSR specifically, and one hands-on critique warns to avoid Suspense (used in streaming SSR) due to unresolved performance issues in SolidStart routing. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of streaming SSR performance, resolution of the Suspense/SolidStart slowness critique.
